# The refused figure is on the *second* split, not the first.
#
# By the time it is judged, the bank split has already been attached to the
# transaction under construction — so what the book is left holding when the
# refusal lands is a different question from the one a first-split refusal
# asks, where nothing had been attached yet and there was nothing to see.
#
# What this fixture produces: one error naming 18.191, and a book with no
# trace of the transaction — not an entry carrying the bank split alone, and
# not an edit left open on one. The good transaction beside it still lands,
# which is why the failure is collected rather than raised.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_refused_figure_leaves_no_wreckage.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fuel
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-01 * "An ordinary lunch"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Fuel 18.19 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -18.19 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-02 * "A tenth of a cent, on the second line"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Fuel 18.19 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -18.191 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
